title: smallanthus fruticosus
intro: Smallanthus fruticosus, commonly known as Jerusalem artichoke, is a perennial plant native to North America. It has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as regulating blood sugar levels and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and prebiotic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Smallanthus fruticosus include inulin, cynarin, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
